additional_images_upload.name: Additional House Photos (Optional)
additional_images_upload.question:
Great, your main photo has been received! If you have additional photos of this same side of your home taken from different angles, distances, or perspectives (such as closer shots or views from the left or right while still facing this same elevation), please upload them here.

These additional photos help us better understand your home's architecture and create the most accurate design possible.

supporting_files_upload.name: Supporting Files Upload (Optional)
supporting_files_upload.question:
Have any project files you'd like to share? Feel free to upload them here!

This could include surveys, site plans, PDFs, SketchUp models (.SKP), architectural drawings, inspiration images, or any other documents that will help us better understand your project.

If you don't have any supporting files, simply continue to the next step, you can always add them later!

project_goals_or_brief_description.name: Project Goals/Brief Description
project_goals_or_brief_description.question: In a few sentences, tell me what you'd love to accomplish with this project. Feel free to share any goals, challenges, or ideas you already have in mind; I'd love to hear them!

landscape_design_style_preference.name: Landscape Design Style Preference
landscape_design_style_preference.question: Do you have a preferred landscape style or overall look you're drawn to? For example, you might love something clean and modern, classic and timeless, natural and relaxed, or something completely unique to you!

hardscape_material_preferences.name: Hardscape / Material Preferences
hardscape_material_preferences.question: Are there any hardscape materials you'd like me to keep in mind for this design? This could include things like pavers, natural stone, brick, concrete, or even a specific color palette or finish you love; I'd be happy to consider it as I put everything together!

softscape_planting_preferences.name: Softscape / Planting Preferences
softscape_planting_preferences.question: Are there any plant styles, colors, or types you'd like me to keep in mind? This could include things like low-maintenance plantings, evergreen structure, flowering shrubs, privacy screening, ornamental trees, or any overall look you love. I'd be happy to keep it in mind as I put everything together!

budget.name: Budget
budget.question: What investment range feels most comfortable for this project? This will help me tailor the design direction to something that feels like the right fit for you!

important_proprty_information.name: Important Property Information
important_proprty_information.question: Is there anything about your property you'd like me to know before I get started on the design?
